_comment_: Real-harness baseline for dogfood-seed.hcl. Records the expected-pass outcome per task. The eval-gate compare step gates on per-task outcome only (a baseline pass that becomes a current fail is a regression); traces, timings, and temp paths are intentionally omitted to keep the baseline deterministic. Regenerate by re-running the suite with the gate's provider and model (see eval/suites/README.md) and re-minimising if task behaviour legitimately changes. 2026-07-11: generated from a live run on claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, then the CI eval-gate model; source runId eval-1783804915791. 2026-07-12 (#494): disambiguated add-go-file-passing-test's prompt ("Create a Go module at module-root" -> "Create a Go module in a new directory named `module-root/`") to fix a flake where the gate model sometimes ran `go mod init` in the workspace root instead of a module-root/ subdirectory, causing the judge's `cd module-root` to fail. 2026-07-30: the gate moved to openai/gpt-5.6-luna over OpenRouter (cost); re-verified 5/5 against runId eval-1785442765558. Per-task outcomes are unchanged across all three revisions. The same commit fixed the false positive that had made narrow-edit-leaves-surroundings-alone flaky since 2026-07-25 — the runner's workspace path matched the OpenAI-key detector and latched Rule-of-Two, revoking run_command mid-run — so a fresh failure of that task is a real regression, NOT the known flake.
